description: Represents the association between an Amazon Macie administrator account and a member account. Creating this resource associates the specified account with the Macie administrator account that performs the operation; deleting it removes the association.

Tag.description: A key-value pair to associate with the Amazon Macie member account.

Key.description: The key of the tag. The maximum length of a tag key is 128 characters.
